key_concepts: Waste management uses the 5Rs: reduce, reuse, recycle, recover, repair
Proper waste management can help reduce flooding, air pollution, ozone depletion, and glob
Reuse means using an item again instead of throwing it away
Recycle means making something into a new product
Reduce means using less to create a smaller amount of waste
Recover means getting useful materials or energy from waste
Repair means fixing broken items so they can be used again
Old clothes and towels can be reused as cleaning rags
Empty plastic bottles can be recycled into new objects
